articles.title: Arbitrum jumps 19% benefitting from Robinhood's $568 million onchain trading frenzy
articles.snippet: The brokerage's new blockchain is off to a fast start, with memecoin trading boosting activity and revenue flowing back to the Arbitrum ecosystem.

articles.title: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks
articles.snippet: Robinhood Chain is an Ethereum layer-2 network built with Arbitrum technology for tokenized assets, crypto apps, and on-chain financial products.

articles.title: Kraken Wins $22M From Auditor That Abandoned It During Operation Choke Point 2.0
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange says an arbitrator sided with it after accounting firm Mazars walked away from a nearly finished audit.
